scoped_instruction_restoration.scope: Accessed-ancestor rule injection and unseen-rule write/process gate only; serial tools and fixed compaction threshold retained.
scoped_instruction_restoration.reason: User requested isolated restoration after offline diagnosis found occasional saved rule reads; live performance benefit remains unverified.

live_result.observed_mechanism: All 15 successful runs explicitly read candidate/AGENTS.md, including all seven restored runs. In seven matched successful pairs, requests fall from 93 to 89: five model round trips saved by tool batching offset one net extra tool; explicit rule reads remain 7 versus 7 and artifact reads 5 versus 5. No unseen-rule gate rejection occurred. These trajectories show no saved rule reads from automatic injection, and do not establish that P3 caused the different model batching choices.
live_result.interpretation: All 16 slots attempted once; original five-run results and continuation prefix preserved, source/usage/success audits passed. Seven both-successful pairs across four tasks: restored requests -6.5% (exploratory interval -17.2% to +2.1%), time +1.6% (-7.8% to +11.1%), total tokens -3.4% (-13.6% to +4.9%). Two task means improve and two worsen; no stable performance or completion benefit established. Successful-only group means have unequal task coverage, so matched results are primary. Run 005 remains a gateway rate_limit failure with unknown final request usage, not a success or evidence of P3 correctness regression. The scheduled continuation completed all 11 unused slots without another infrastructure failure. P3 remains restored; parallel scheduler and usage calibration remain absent. No further model calls.

scoped_instruction_removal.reason: The 90-trial P3 ablation did not demonstrate completion or performance gains. Remove path observation, nested-rule injection and its tool retry gate; retain project-wide rules, memory, multimodal input, steering and intent routing.

offline_diagnosis.finding: The second state-compatibility pair contributes 125.267s and 51321 tokens of the pooled increase (174.401s and 54826 tokens): five extra requests, including four from unbatched reads and one artifact reread. Per-request latency also differs; the same initial directory call takes 4.607s versus 18.077s with equal output tokens/cache reads. Client logs cannot isolate server queue time. Shared cheap shortening stores the old source result before editing in the slower trajectory; this code was not removed or changed.
offline_diagnosis.module_assessment: Native parallel reads were disabled in both versions; journal tool starts do not overlap. Usage calibration only controls full-history compaction, which never ran; cheap shortening still ran. P3 is the only removed module with observed semantic prompt changes and sometimes saves an explicit nested-rule read. However prior scoped-off runs 031/068 also batch reads, so batching differences are not demonstrated consequences of removing P3. Tool schemas and wire generation options are identical. The old scoped_instructions_present substring flag does not prove automatic injection; diagnosis checks the actual instruction section.
offline_diagnosis.decision: Do not restore on this evidence alone. P3 rule injection is the only plausible restoration candidate; no basis here for restoring the parallel scheduler or token calibration. Combined performance differences do not establish individual causal effects.

live_pruning_comparison.interpretation: No demonstrated completion, latency or token benefit from combined removal. Both-successful paired task means are slower after removal in all four tasks; tokens increase in three. Exploratory task-cluster intervals: time +3.2% to +36.4%, total tokens approximately 0% to +23.4%. Only four tasks and two repetitions; provider load, cache, sampling and interrupted phases prevent a stable-regression claim. Successful-only group medians have unequal task coverage; paired results are primary. No full-history compaction occurred and native parallel reads were inactive, so this cannot isolate each removed module. The file-slice task was excluded before execution because of its known native temporary-directory confound. All 16 slots attempted once, original records and phase prefixes preserved, source/usage/success checks passed. Two failed requests have unknown final usage; no further model calls.

live_code_ablation_round3.interpretation: No demonstrated completion advantage in matched non-infrastructure trials. Task-weighted paired changes: P3 time +8.7%, total tokens +2.7%; routing disabled time +5.5%, tokens +11.4%. Secondary analysis excluding the whole file task: P3 time +2.7%, tokens -0.1%; routing disabled time -3.4%, tokens +7.6%. Intervals are exploratory with six task clusters. Native temporary-directory creation remains unverified and caused verification timeouts. The budget-exhausted run remains failed despite passing tests. All 90 frozen slots were attempted once; combined campaign-results.json preserves original results.json and phase prefixes. Three model failures retain unknown final usage; HTTP 200 stream interruption is classified from the recorded ModelCallError. No pending trials or further model calls.

live_code_ablation_round2.interpretation: Rate limit interrupted run 16; no automatic retry. First 15 runs have equal task/repetition coverage per condition. Budget-exhausted runs remain failures despite passing tests. P3 can complete these tasks but its advantage is not established. Disabling routing shows no consistent speedup and raises total tokens in 3/4 matched successful pairs (median change +16.0%). All-attempt consumption is retained; the failed request has unknown usage.

live_component_pilot.interpretation: Explore ownership repair confirmed; routing latency inconclusive; scoped outputs correct but both turns budget-limited; storage microbenchmark improved. P2 and native parallel-read speed not isolated.
